newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CRISIL gives AA+ to SAIL bonds.
newsitem.headline: India's CRISIL gives AA+ to SAIL bonds.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it had assigned a AA+ rating to state-run Steel Authority of India's (SAIL) 7.67-billion-rupee bonds issue.
CRISIL said in a statement that the steel industry, which had remained under pressure due to increased steel supply and weak demand, had affected SAIL's working capital requirements and realisations.
"The situation is likely to remain competitive over the medium term," the statement said. "Overall SAIL's profitability, coverage and gearing levels are expected to be under pressure accordingly."
Earlier on Wednesday, the Steel Ministry said that SAIL's net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) was estimated at 6.53 billion rupees, down from 13.19 billion in the previous fiscal year.
For 1997/98, SAIL's net profit is projected at 7.40 billion rupees, the ministry said in its annual performance budget.
